questions.subject: INTEGRATED_1
questions.topic: Solving a triangle with the law of sines
questions.learningObjective: Explain when law of sines solves a triangle
questions.stem: A study group asks when the law of sines can solve a triangle. Explain.

answer.exemplar: The law of sines works when at least one angle-side pair is known, such as AAS or ASA, to find missing sides or angles, and it cannot start from three sides alone.

questions.explanation: An angle-side pair lets the sine proportion relate unknowns. A tempting wrong idea is that SSS alone suffices.
